tagline:
Archive your dream today.
Break it into steps you can do.
spoken: [hook] Your goal has no date. That's why it's not moving. || Get fit sounds like a goal, but there's nothing to check. No number, no deadline, so every week feels the same. || [turn] Rewrite it with a number and a date. Get fit becomes, run five K by March first. || Now you can count. That's eighteen weeks from today, and this week has a job. Three easy runs, twenty minutes each. || Same with reading. Read more becomes twelve books by December thirty first. That's one book a month. || [land] Here's the test. If you can't tell whether this week was on track, the goal still needs a number or a date. || [outro] That's what Dmyor is for. You archive your dream today, so you can see it tomorrow, and break it down into small steps you can actually do. || [outro] If you want to try it out, I've put the link in the bio.

caption.instagram:
Your goal has no date. That's why it's not moving.

• "Get fit" → "Run 5K by March 1"
• That's 18 weeks, and this week has a job: 3 easy runs, 20 min each
• "Read more" → "12 books by Dec 31" = one a month

The test: if you can't tell whether this week was on track, add a number or a date.
